resources.string: A layered paper-cutout landscape that scrolls across your screen, with the sun and moon following the time of day.
Real current conditions replace each theme\'s manual rain/snow/cloud settings automatically, refreshed hourly. While on, this theme\'s own Clouds/Precipitation screens switch to read-only.
Pick a location above first - GPS, Network or Custom - so it knows where to check the weather for.
Location unavailable — showing this theme\'s own weather instead.

When on, PaperScrape asks GitHub for a newer release each time you open these settings. To also hear about one while the wallpaper is on screen, turn on the notification below. Off by default; the button below always works.

Puts a quiet notification in the shade when a newer release appears. No sound and no pop-up. Only while PaperScrape is your wallpaper and on screen; it checks about once a day, and again whenever the wallpaper restarts.
Turn \"Check for updates automatically\" on first - this is how PaperScrape tells you what that check found. Your choice here is kept until then.
Notifications are switched off for PaperScrape in your phone\'s settings, so nothing would appear.
A quiet note when a newer release of PaperScrape is out. At most one per version, and no sound. PaperScrape checks about once a day while it is your wallpaper and on screen.
You have v%1$s. Tap to see what\'s new.
